limitations: Only a two-point spectrum with a single nonzero eigenvalue; no general nonflat-spectrum risk formula.
Unnormalized independent real Gaussian probes and exact arithmetic; normalized variants have different, possibly zero variance.
Correction to squared-error indicator is unbiased only in expectation within the specified model; not a realized-error certificate.
Novelty assessment retains the possibility of unindexed earlier exact exchangeable-trace specializations.
scientific_scope: Exact unnormalized Gaussian FlexTrace trace and leave-one-out indicator for a positive scalar multiple of an orthogonal projector, any ambient dimension at least its rank, and any positive probe count; the spectral function vanishes at zero.
title: Exact flat-spectrum risk and error-indicator calibration for exchangeable Nyström traces
